“Oh, they are nothing difficult. Only these: I want the well and the surroundings for the space of half a mile, entirely to myself from sunset to-day until I remove the ban—and nobody allowed to cross the ground but by my authority.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“Are these all?”", "sha256": "4d6e5919d4f5c631dd141566ac230cdeb52aed2203c75ec772ee8a729f569195", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[19]", "source_html": "

“Are these all?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes.”", "sha256": "838a04296799794f4e1a85c40540fd52027a3aa3d6a1cd735f69b489839212cf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[20]", "source_html": "

“Yes.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“And you have no fear to try?”", "sha256": "fd4fc411d67177aeda589974ef2efa9b2965ef03150a4300686389962d78cd7f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[21]", "source_html": "

“Oh, none. One may fail, of course; and one may also succeed. One can try, and I am ready to chance it. I have my conditions?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“These and all others ye may name. I will issue commandment to that effect.”", "sha256": "d920f1abb401f7358ab661fc52505775a81680237abee4a9015081cd6760a362", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[23]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“Wait,” said Merlin, with an evil smile. “Ye wit that he that would break this spell must know that spirit’s name?”", "sha256": "71be6dc63accdc9616a8fa40ef135b26d2ea89f31251fe5ea8c73230ef96c6ba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[24]", "source_html": "

“Wait,” said Merlin, with an evil smile. “Ye wit that he that would break this spell must know that spirit’s name?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes, I know his name.”", "sha256": "23f466650e442752b7bdb7d9484ff2ee887744495a30f62fdcb488f75c4ad3f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[25]", "source_html": "

“Yes, I know his name.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“And wit you also that to know it skills not of itself, but ye must likewise pronounce it? Ha-ha! “And wit you also that to know it skills not of itself, but ye must likewise pronounce it? Ha-ha! Knew ye that?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes, I knew that, too.”", "sha256": "f0c66369181d3b07ea241ea6c2e68194d177c6e5c3a5480edf9fca9075dcca0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[27]", "source_html": "

“Yes, I knew that, too.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u027-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“You had that knowledge! Art a fool? Are ye minded to utter that name and die?”", "sha256": "8229b17de241a819ab6531af33ccff2de4016dbed72f863f83ea78c2bd744629", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[31]/p[28]", "source_html": "

“You had that knowledge! Art a fool? Are ye minded to utter that name and die?”

“Utter it? Why certainly. I would utter it if it was Welsh.”
